about: Hunter step 2's box trap creatures, where live has them: ferrets and chinchompas in the Piscatoris Hunter area, carnivorous chinchompas in the Feldip Hunter area and the red chinchompa hunting ground under it (reached by ::tele; its cave entrance isn't built). Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022). Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: chinchompas in Kourend Woodland, the Isle of Souls and Varlamore, carnivorous chinchompas in the Gwenith Hunter area and Varlamore, black chinchompas (the Wilderness thread).
